title: Initialize Distance Matrix
description: Create a V×V matrix where dist[i][j] = weight of edge (i,j) if it exists, 0 if i=j, and infinity otherwise. Initialize the predecessor matrix for path reconstruction.

title: Consider Each Intermediate Node
description: For each node k (from 0 to V-1), consider it as a potential intermediate node for all pairs of nodes (i,j). This is the outermost loop of the triple nested iteration.

title: Evaluate Path Through Intermediate
description: For each pair (i,j), compare the current best distance dist[i][j] with the path going through k: dist[i][k] + dist[k][j].

title: Update Distance if Shorter
description: If the path through k is shorter than the current best, update dist[i][j] = dist[i][k] + dist[k][j] and set predecessor[i][j] = predecessor[k][j].

title: Check for Negative Cycles
description: After processing all k, check the diagonal: if any dist[i][i] < 0, a negative cycle exists involving node i.
